steps.title: Use the item it dropped
steps.text: Lythara leaves an item behind when she dies. Use it: the Spirit is granted then, not at the kill.

quests.notes: Done on the reward line in Kriar Village. Listed in poe2db's community table of permanent rewards, not as a quest page. The last step exists because the reward line follows Lythara's last line by 10 to 15 s, which fits a player action after the kill; like Beira's, inferred to be the use of an item the boss dropped. The log records nothing of that use, so the step has no signal and the reward line finishes the quest. poe2db does not name the item.
